Quality control of the standard station table

Source: R/prep-qc.R
ef_station_qc.Rd

Runs the quality control tests of the station data (dev/specs/weather-forcing.md section 3) on an earthflux_station_table and returns the table with the audit of every condition found, the diagnostic flag records and the status of each observed value under an explicit QC policy. Values are never deleted or modified: observations is returned unchanged.

Usage

ef_station_qc(x, qc_policy = "exclude_critical")

Arguments

x

An earthflux_station_table built with ef_station_table() (or the result of a previous ef_station_qc(), which is recomputed).

qc_policy

Character. Which flagged values are excluded: "exclude_critical" (default; the values with a critical flag, i.e. physical or logical impossibilities), "exclude_warning" (values with a critical or warning flag) or "keep_all" (no exclusion; for audit). Exact match.

Value

An object of class c("earthflux_station_qc", "earthflux_station_table", "list"): the elements of x (stations and observations unchanged) plus

  • qc: the long audit table, one row per record, variable and flag code that holds, with columns row (row of observations), station_id, timestamp (UTC), variable (the observed variable, or "timestamp" for the time tests), flag_code (a registered code), severity, test_id (test of dev/specs/weather-forcing.md section 3.2), value (the value tested: the variable, the height, or the seconds since the previous record), threshold (the bound it was compared with: a domain limit, 100 %, the other variable of a consistency test, the standard height or the time step; NA if none) and parameters (NA: no class II parameter is used);

  • flags: one earthflux_flag record (scope record, index = rows of observations, n_total = number of records) per code that holds somewhere; the rows of qc with that code are exactly its index;

  • qc_status: a data frame with station_id, timestamp and one factor column per observed variable (levels "ok", "warning", "excluded"), aligned with the rows of observations;

  • provenance: the provenance of x with flags_evaluated (codes evaluated), flags (registry rows of the codes evaluated, policy and counts; dev/specs/flags.md section 6.7), qc (policy, counts by code, values excluded by variable, tests not evaluated) and a new row in operations.

Details

Tests evaluated (codes registered in the flag registry; severity in brackets):

  • EF_WS_OUT_OF_DOMAIN [critical] (QC-01a): physically impossible value: relative humidity (relative_humidity, rh_max, rh_min) < 0, wind_speed < 0, temperature (air_temperature, dewpoint_temperature, tmax, tmin) <= -273.15 degC, air_pressure <= 0, vapour_pressure < 0, solar_radiation < 0, precipitation < 0. A negative solar radiation (for example the night-time offset of a thermopile pyranometer) is excluded by the default policy; it is not set to zero.

  • EF_WS_TMIN_GT_TMAX [critical] (QC-03): tmin > tmax in the same record; both variables are flagged.

  • EF_WS_RH_GT100 [info] (QC-02): relative humidity > 100 %. Values slightly above 100 % occur (e.g. early morning or rain); FAO-56 Annex 5 relates records exceeding 100 % by more than 3-5 % to a need of recalibration, a class II test not evaluated until its margin is chosen (WF-06).

  • EF_WS_TDEW_GT_TAIR [warning] (QC-04): dewpoint_temperature > air_temperature, or vapour_pressure greater than the saturation vapour pressure at air_temperature (\(e_a > e^\circ(T)\), ef_es()), without tolerance (both are equivalent to a relative humidity above 100 %, FAO-56 Eqs. 10, 11 and 14); the variables compared are flagged (the air temperature once per record). The threshold is the air temperature for the dew point, \(e^\circ(T)\) for the vapour pressure and the dew point of the vapour pressure (ef_dewpoint()) for the air temperature.

  • EF_WS_RS_GT_RA [warning] (QC-05b): the mean solar_radiation of the record is greater than the mean extraterrestrial radiation of the same time window (the window of interval seconds of the record, located by timestamp_convention). The extraterrestrial radiation is the integral of FAO-56 Eq. 28 over the part of the window with the sun above the horizon (for a one-day window, Eq. 21). Windows with the sun below the horizon during the whole window (night-time radiation, test QC-05d, class II) are not tested. Evaluated for period means (timestamp_convention "end" or "start") with an interval of at most one day.

  • EF_WS_TIME_GAP [warning] and EF_WS_TIME_IRREGULAR [warning] (QC-09), per station in time order: the time since the previous record is a whole multiple (two or more) of the declared interval (gap: the record after the gap is flagged), or not a whole multiple (irregular step); variable "timestamp". Missing time steps are never filled.

  • EF_WS_HEIGHT_MISSING [warning] and EF_WS_HEIGHT_NONSTANDARD [warning] (QC-11): a non-missing value whose measurement height is NA (height_wind for wind_speed; height_temp_rh for temperature and humidity variables), or temperature and humidity measured at a height different from 2 m (FAO-56 chapters 2-3); no correction is applied.

A code is evaluated only when the variables it needs are present; the codes evaluated are listed in provenance$flags_evaluated, so that "evaluated and absent" is distinguishable from "not evaluated".

Not evaluated: the class II tests of dev/specs/weather-forcing.md section 3.2 (plausible ranges, recalibration margin of the humidity sensor, clear-sky envelope and calibration of the pyranometer, night radiation, persistence, steps, low maximum humidity, non-reference conditions, diurnal stability of the vapour pressure, time shift, spatial consistency, cloudy overpass): they need thresholds with a documented reference that are not available, so their codes are not registered and no threshold is assumed. Also not evaluated here: EF_WS_INCOMPLETE_DAY (QC-10), which depends on the definition of the day and is raised by the daily sums of ef_station_ref_et(). They are listed in provenance$qc$not_evaluated (with EF_WS_RS_GT_RA when the table has solar radiation that cannot be tested).

Status and policy. The status of an observed value is the highest severity among the flags of its record that concern its variable or the timestamp: "excluded" if that severity is excluded by qc_policy, "warning" if it is warning (or critical under "keep_all"), and "ok" otherwise (no flag or info). Missing values keep the status of their record. Excluding is not deleting: observations keeps the value and the flag that motivated the exclusion is kept; the counts are in provenance$qc.

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration - Guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56. FAO, Rome. ISBN 92-5-104219-5.

See also

ef_station_table(), ef_station_ref_et().

Examples

stations <- data.frame(
  station_id = "ST01", lon = -71.5, lat = -35.4, elevation = 150,
  height_wind = 2, height_temp_rh = 2
)
times <- as.POSIXct("2024-01-15 13:00", tz = "UTC") + 3600 * c(0, 1, 3)
observations <- data.frame(
  station_id = "ST01", timestamp = times,
  air_temperature = c(24.1, 25.3, 26.0),
  relative_humidity = c(45, -3, 101),
  wind_speed = c(2.1, 2.6, 3.0)
)
st <- ef_station_table(
  stations, observations,
  provenance = list(timestamp_convention = "end", interval = 3600,
                    crs = "EPSG:4326")
)
qc <- ef_station_qc(st)
qc
#> <earthflux_station_qc>
#> Stations: 1 (coordinates EPSG:4326)
#> Records: 3, 2024-01-15 13:00:00 to 2024-01-15 16:00:00 UTC (source time zone: UTC)
#> Time step: 3600 s; timestamps mark the end of each period
#> Variables: air_temperature [degC], relative_humidity [%], wind_speed [m/s] 
#> Quality control: policy "exclude_critical"; 6 code(s) evaluated
#>   EF_WS_OUT_OF_DOMAIN        critical 1 record(s), 1 value(s)
#>   EF_WS_RH_GT100             info     1 record(s), 1 value(s)
#>   EF_WS_TIME_GAP             warning  1 record(s), 1 value(s)
#> Values excluded: 1; with warning: 3 (see `qc_status`)
qc$qc
#>   row station_id           timestamp          variable           flag_code
#> 1   2       ST01 2024-01-15 14:00:00 relative_humidity EF_WS_OUT_OF_DOMAIN
#> 2   3       ST01 2024-01-15 16:00:00 relative_humidity      EF_WS_RH_GT100
#> 3   3       ST01 2024-01-15 16:00:00         timestamp      EF_WS_TIME_GAP
#>   severity test_id value threshold parameters
#> 1 critical  QC-01a    -3         0       <NA>
#> 2     info   QC-02   101       100       <NA>
#> 3  warning   QC-09  7200      3600       <NA>
qc$qc_status
#>   station_id           timestamp air_temperature relative_humidity wind_speed
#> 1       ST01 2024-01-15 13:00:00              ok                ok         ok
#> 2       ST01 2024-01-15 14:00:00              ok          excluded         ok
#> 3       ST01 2024-01-15 16:00:00         warning           warning    warning
